mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, we are experiencing dense drizzle with temperatures sitting at 55 degrees near Verona City Hall under a waxing crescent moon.

Important information for residents: the City of Verona has updated its polling locations for the November 3 general election. Please use the My Vote Wisconsin website to confirm your specific ward and polling station before election day, as your location may have changed.

There is plenty to do in our community this week! Today, you can catch yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night events at the ART House, or play trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or at Lake Lou-ee.
Looking at the weekly police report, officers responded to a motor vehicle crash on October 7 involving a juvenile on an electric motorcycle near Basswood Avenue and Hemlock Drive.
Today's delicious flavor of the day at Culver's is Crazy for Cookie Dough. The restaurant is currently open, so feel free to stop by anytime before they close at 10 PM.
